metadata.description: Tooling for turning a published specification into executable conformance tests, and publishing them as a FHIR implementation guide with TestPlan resources.

plugins.name: otb-testing
plugins.description: Specification to conformance tests: scope, case list, Gherkin, compile, run on an Interoperability Test Bed, publish as a FHIR IG with one TestPlan per actor. Includes extending the test language with a new dialect.
